svg.title: AIcoach upload and analysing — broadcast telestrator
svg.text: One swing clip, filmed down the line. You’ll see each step of the analysis as it runs.
mp4 or mov, max 15 seconds. Other formats or longer clips are refused before analysis.

text.tspan: If you turn this on, the swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it. Left off, it is deleted after

svg.text: Analysis runs on the AIcoach server. Only measurements reach the language model.
Seen from above — phone behind you, down the line

text.tspan: From behind, pointing along the target line. Face-on is not
Level, on or parallel to the hands line at address.
On a tripod or a stable surface, like your bag.
Recommended. Under 120 fps, no measurement gets high

svg.text: Whole body and club in frame

text.tspan: For the full swing, in good light.

svg.text: Don’t close this tab. Nothing is guessed: if the video can’t support a result, you’ll get “Cannot analyse” with the reasons.

text.tspan: Hip movement, posture angle, hand path
Early extension, loss of posture, over the top
Plain-language write-up from the analysis data
